verses.text: To the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm

tok.t: To the choir director. Of the

verses.text: Hear this, all you peoples; Give ear, all you inhabitants of the world,
Both low and high, Rich and poor together;
My mouth will speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be that of understanding.
I will incline my ear to a parable; I will disclose my riddle upon the harp.

verses.text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, When the iniquity of those who supplant me surrounds me,

verses.text: Those who trust in their wealth And boast in the multitude of their riches?
None can by any means redeem his brother Or give to God a ransom for him
(For the redemption of their soul is costly And must be given up forever),

verses.text: That he would yet live always And not see corruption.
For he will see that wise men die; The foolish one and the senseless one perish alike And leave their wealth to others.
